summary: VacantEntry::insert could replace an occupied slot containing an outdated key version. Unconditionally incrementing num_elems double-counted that slot, and forgetting the replaced slot leaked its value. The fix drops the replaced value and increments num_elems only when the previous slot was actually vacant. A verbatim implementation reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision: the fix adds no tests, secondary::tests::qc_secmap_equiv_hashmap uses direct insertion rather than entry insertion, and the entry doctests do not replace stale occupied slots. Test selection is empty, so this candidate must remain blocked; no reproduction was attempted.
